_comment: Everything the client and patcher need to know about game memory. 'verified' stays false until every entry below has been confirmed on a real ROM (see docs/CALIBRATION.md). A null entry means 'not yet known' and disables the feature that needs it instead of guessing. Table shapes: {"address": "0x...", "kind": "bitfield|bytes|u8|u16|u32", "size": N}; state flags may add "values": [..] listing the byte values that mean yes. optional_tables only back individual traps and may stay null in a verified map; a trap whose entries are null is dropped at generation.

ap_block._comment: ROM region written by the patch with the seed/slot identity. The patcher refuses to write unless the whole region is still blank (0xFF).

hints._comment: Unverified pointers from the community randomizer's reverse-engineering notes. Use them as starting points for calibration only; they are never read by the client.

party_slot_struct.note: Byte 0 = state, byte 2 = medal id, bytes 3-6 = head/right arm/left arm/legs model IDs (written by the starter-equip routine at ROM offset 0x044B58).

flags_byte.note: OR-ed with 0xC0 by the starter-equip routine.
